usage: deskops edit [-h]
                    {task,pill,ritual,board,atom,materialization,repository,inbox-note,faq-doc,step} ...

positional arguments:
  {task,pill,ritual,board,atom,materialization,repository,inbox-note,faq-doc,step}
    task                Edit one task field.
    pill                Edit one pill field.
    ritual              Edit one ritual field.
    board               Edit one board field.
    atom                Edit one atom field.
    materialization     Edit one materialization field.
    repository          Edit one repository field.
    inbox-note          Edit one inbox-note field.
    faq-doc             Edit one faq-doc field.
    step                Edit one step field.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops edit task task-fix-thing goal "Updated goal" --root .
  deskops edit pill pill-keep-layers-clean how-not "Do not bypass the guardrail." --root .

Values are parsed with SLDB's field-value parser and the document is re-rendered through its model.
Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
